title: Mission stage
description: A full-window stage for a 3D scene drawn on the course sky, without a frame. On wide screens the title and the brief float over the top left of the stage, where the scene leaves the sky free; on narrow screens they sit above it.
instructions: Put one free object with aspectRatio fill in the stage, and a brief of two or three sentences. The object should leave the left third of its view free for the brief (phasing-lab does).
